quests.canDoWhy: Found by exploring: the journal opens when you meet Katria's ghost in the Dwarven ruin of Arkngthamz.

choices.choice: Accept Katria's help in Arkngthamz, or go on without her
choices.leadsTo: Either way she warns you about the tonal lock and the traps, and the quest goes on the same

choices.choice: Which artifact to make at the Aetherium Forge: Aetherial Shield, Aetherium Crown or Aetherial Staff
choices.leadsTo: Making one uses up the Aetherium Crest. The Forge also lists versions of all three that take 2 Aetherium Dynamo Cores instead of the Crest, so with cores you can make the others too.

objectives: Search for the Aetherium Shards (shards found / total)
Defeat the Guardians of the Forge

rewards.what: One Aetherium artifact of your choice, made at the Aetherium Forge: Aetherial Shield (2 Refined Malachite, 4 Dwarven Metal Ingots), Aetherium Crown (2 Gold Ingots, 2 Flawless Sapphires, 2 Dwarven Metal Ingots) or Aetherial Staff (2 Ebony Ingots, 1 Gold Ingot, 2 Dwarven Metal Ingots), each also needing the Aetherium Crest, or 2 Aetherium Dynamo Cores in its place
Aetherium Crown: "Allows you to have 3 Standing Stone effects at the same time, at double the effectiveness. If you're not under the effect of any Stones, restores 10 Magicka per second."
Aetherial Shield: "Enemies struck by this shield become ethereal for 15 seconds, making them unable to attack or be attacked."
A chest of crafting materials beside the Forge
Kate's Bow becomes craftable at a forge (3 Iron Ingots, 2 Leather Strips; needs the Craftsmanship perk)

people.name: Katria
people.role: ghost of an adventurer who died in Arkngthamz; guides you, then meets you again at the Forge entrance and at the Forge

people.name: Katria's body
people.role: in Arkngthamz, with her journal (optional objective)

people.name: The Forgemaster
people.role: guardian of the Aetherium Forge

unsure.why: The quest runs silently before you meet Katria, and the records here don't show what first switches it on. It holds the book The Aetherium Wars and other lead-in books (two of them on adventurers' bodies out in the wilds), so reading one of those is the likely lead, but that isn't confirmed.

The four shard sites come from the quest's cells (Raldbthar Deep Market, the Dwarven Storeroom) and the book Uncovering the Aetherium Forge (Raldbthar, a storeroom outside Mzulft, atop Deep Folk Crossing); which shard alias sits where isn't spelled out in these files. The shard total is a global whose value isn't given; the journal says four.

The quest script points at the Aetherium Crown only; the three forge recipes all need the Aetherium Crest you carry. A patch also adds versions that use 2 Aetherium Dynamo Cores instead of the Crest. The Aetherial Staff's effect text isn't in these files.

The Aetherium Wars calls Arkngthamz 'the great research center in the southern Reach', and a follower's line says the same; the places index puts it in Falkreath hold with Dragon Bridge and Morthal as nearest towns, which doesn't fit. I went with the book.
Whether the Forge can still be used after the quest ends (to make the other artifacts with Dynamo Cores) isn't shown in these files.
